item.summary: Taking an important step towards strengthening the cooperative movement in the country and making it a powerful instrument of self-reliance and public welfare, a Cooperative Festival was organised today in Itanagar, the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, under the vision of ‘Sahkar Se Samriddhi’ of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and the guidance of Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit…
item.title: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah unveils ‘Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047’ and launches various development projects in Itanagar
